name: Bedroom Mirror Flash Snapshot
title: 1980s Bedroom Mirror Photo Prompt for ChatGPT & Gemini
description: A candid flash shot of you in an old bedroom mirror, floral bedspread behind. This 1980s bedroom mirror photo prompt works in ChatGPT and Gemini.
prompt: Using my uploaded photo, turn it into a candid 1980s snapshot of me photographing my reflection in a bedroom mirror. Keep my face, facial features, skin tone, age and body proportions exactly as in the photo and clearly recognisable; no slimming, smoothing or beautifying. Give me a soft crimped perm pushed to one side with a banana clip, a slouchy lilac mohair jumper over a white camisole and stonewashed jeans, hoop earrings. I hold a compact point-and-shoot at chest height, one hand tucked in my hair, half-smiling. Behind me in the glass: a floral quilted bedspread, a cork board of pinned postcards with no legible writing. The on-camera flash bursts as a bright white starburst in the mirror, with hard shadows on the wallpaper. Shot on 35mm consumer colour film, warm yellow cast, coarse grain, orange date stamp. No smartphone, no modern objects, no readable text or logos, not a filter, not an illustration.
intro: Before phones, a mirror shot meant holding up a film camera and hoping the flash did not wipe out your face. That clumsy honesty is exactly why this look is so popular in the 1980s trend: it feels private and unposed, like a print you took yourself and forgot in a drawer, rather than a studio portrait someone else arranged.
creates: The edit shows you standing at a dressing-table mirror, reflected with a small film camera held at chest level. Your hair is a crimped side perm with a banana clip, and you wear a lilac mohair jumper and stonewashed jeans. The flash appears as a white starburst in the glass, the bedroom behind has a floral bedspread and pinned postcards, and the colours are warm, grainy and slightly soft with an orange date stamp.
works: The line "photographing my reflection" sets the mirror framing, while "no smartphone" stops the model defaulting to a modern selfie. Asking for "a bright white starburst in the mirror" and "hard shadows on the wallpaper" recreates the flaw that makes real flash mirror shots believable. "No slimming, smoothing or beautifying" keeps your features intact, and "consumer colour film" with a "warm yellow cast" gives the cheap-print feel instead of a glossy render.
tips: Upload a waist-up photo where your face is fully visible and unobstructed, because the camera in the new image will cover part of your chest, not your face.
If the flash glare lands on your face, add "keep the flash starburst beside my head, not over it" and regenerate.
Swap the lilac mohair jumper for an oversized sweatshirt with the neckline cut off, or change the bedspread to tartan for a different bedroom mood.
suits: Anyone joining the 1980s Add Yours sticker who wants something less staged than a studio portrait; it works well as an Instagram story, a profile photo or a side-by-side with a real teenage snapshot.
personalize: Change the jumper, the hair clip and the items on the cork board to things you actually owned or would have owned as a teenager.

name: Lounge Bar Counter Candid
title: 1980s Bar Counter Photo Prompt for ChatGPT & Gemini
description: Put yourself at a dim wooden lounge bar in a candid flash shot. This 1980s bar counter photo prompt works in ChatGPT and Gemini on your own photo.
prompt: Using my uploaded photo, recreate me as a candid 1980s snapshot taken by a friend at a hotel lounge bar. Keep my face, facial features, skin tone, age and body proportions exactly as they are and recognisable; do not beautify or change my build. I lean one elbow on a scratched dark-mahogany counter, chin on my hand, giving the camera a slightly bored, half-amused sideways look. Dress me in a boxy charcoal blazer with the sleeves pushed up over a pale pink shirt, hair full and tousled. On the counter: a short tumbler with ice, a glass ashtray. Behind me, mirrored shelves of bottles with blurred, unreadable labels under amber downlights. Direct on-camera flash lights me flatly while the background falls into warm murk; 35mm colour negative, heavy grain, red-orange cast. No modern objects, no readable text or logos, not a filter, not an illustration.
intro: A late-night bar snapshot has an attitude that studio portraits lack: the slightly tired look, the flash hitting you while the room glows amber behind. It suggests a story without spelling it out, which is why people like placing themselves at a 1980s lounge counter instead of in a posed backdrop.
creates: The result shows you on a bar stool, one elbow on a dark wooden counter and your chin resting on your hand. You wear a boxy charcoal blazer over a pale pink shirt. A tumbler, glass ashtray and napkin sit in front of you, and mirrored shelves of bottles glow amber behind. Your face is lit flat by flash, the background is dim and warm, and the print has heavy grain with a red-orange tint.
works: "Taken by a friend" and "half-amused sideways look" push the model toward a caught-in-the-moment expression rather than a model pose. "Blurred, unreadable labels" prevents invented brand names, which are a common giveaway. "Direct on-camera flash" against "warm murk" creates the lighting split that real bar photos had. The identity lock, "do not beautify or change my build", stops the model tidying your face, and "not a filter" keeps it photographic.
tips: Choose an upload where you are seated or leaning, with your face turned slightly, so the elbow-on-counter pose does not distort your shoulders.
If bottle labels come out with readable fake words, reply "make every label an unreadable blur" and regenerate only the background.
Change the blazer to a sequinned top or a leather bomber, and swap the tumbler for a tall glass with a paper umbrella for a lighter mood.
suits: People who want a moody, grown-up version of the 1980s trend rather than a cheerful family shot; good for an Instagram grid post, a profile picture or a joke caption about a long evening.
personalize: Swap the blazer, the drink on the counter and the colour of the downlights to set the bar in your own imagined city.

name: Scooter Street Romance Still
title: 1980s Scooter Couple Photo Prompt for ChatGPT & Gemini
description: Turn you and your partner into a sunny film still with a scooter and ice cream. This 1980s scooter couple photo prompt works in ChatGPT and Gemini.
prompt: Using the uploaded photo(s), recreate both people as a couple in a sunny 1980s romantic film still. Keep every person's face, facial features, skin tone, age, height and body proportions exactly as in the upload and clearly recognisable; do not merge or beautify anyone. They stand beside a mint-green vintage scooter parked on a sloping street of ochre houses and wooden shutters, each holding a dripping ice cream cone. One leans on the scooter seat laughing while the other offers a taste. Style one in a white short-sleeved shirt, pleated khaki trousers and loafers, the other in a yellow polka-dot sundress with a hair scarf, or adapt the outfits to suit each person. Low late-afternoon sun, long shadows, warm haze. Shot on 35mm cinema film stock, fine grain, gentle halation on highlights, slightly faded colours. No modern cars or objects, no readable signs or logos, not a filter, not an illustration.
intro: Romantic films of the era loved a simple setup: two people, a small scooter, a sunny side street and something sweet to share. It is lighthearted rather than dramatic, and it gives couples a nostalgic picture that feels like a still from a film they starred in, without costumes that look like fancy dress.
creates: The finished image shows both of you on a narrow sloping street lined with ochre houses and wooden shutters, next to a mint-green scooter. Each of you holds an ice cream cone, one laughing against the seat, the other offering a taste. Outfits are a white shirt with pleated khakis and a yellow polka-dot sundress with a hair scarf. Light is low and golden, with long shadows, soft haze and faded film colour.
works: "Keep every person's face" and "do not merge" matter most here, because two-person edits often blend features. "Or adapt the outfits to suit each person" lets the model dress any couple naturally. "35mm cinema film stock" with "gentle halation on highlights" gives the movie-still glow, and "long shadows" fixes the time of day. The closing "no modern cars" and "no readable signs" remove the clutter that gives away a generated street.
tips: Upload one photo where both faces are clear and similar in size; if you only have separate photos, upload both and name who is on the left.
If one face drifts, reply "restore the person on the right to match the uploaded photo exactly" and regenerate that person only.
Swap the scooter colour to red or sky blue, or trade ice cream for a paper bag of roasted peanuts for a different street scene.
suits: Couples marking an anniversary, engaged pairs wanting a playful save-the-date image, or friends joining the 1980s trend together; it posts well as a carousel next to the original photo.
personalize: Change the scooter colour, the street's house colours and each outfit to match your own style and the city you imagine.

name: Old City Fashion Street Portrait
title: 1980s Indian Fashion Photo Prompt for ChatGPT & Gemini
description: Restyle your photo with a bright tucked shirt, high waist and big sunglasses. This 1980s indian fashion photo prompt works in ChatGPT and Gemini.
prompt: Using my uploaded photo, recreate me as a stylish woman on an old Indian city street in the 1980s. Keep my face, facial features, natural skin tone, age and body proportions exactly as they are and clearly recognisable; do not lighten, slim or beautify me. Dress me in a bright tangerine full-sleeve cotton shirt with wide collar and cuffed sleeves, tucked into high-waisted cream pleated trousers with a thin brown belt, and oversized tortoiseshell sunglasses pushed down my nose. Hair in a voluminous blow-dried bob with soft fringe; gold studs, brick-red lipstick. I walk toward the camera mid-stride, one hand on a shoulder bag. Behind me: a weathered colonnade with peeling lime-wash, a cycle-rickshaw and a fruit cart. Bright midday sun, deep shade under the arches. Shot on 35mm slide film, punchy warm colours, visible grain. No modern vehicles or phones, no readable shop signs or logos, not a filter, not an illustration.
intro: Indian street fashion of the 1980s mixed Western cuts with local colour: bold shirts tucked into high waists, big sunglasses, blow-dried hair, all set against busy old bazaars. It is confident and a little cinematic, which makes it a favourite for anyone who wants to look like their stylish aunt in her college days.
creates: The edit shows you mid-stride on a sunlit old street, wearing a tangerine full-sleeve shirt tucked into cream pleated high-waisted trousers with a thin belt. Oversized tortoiseshell sunglasses sit low on your nose, your hair is a full blow-dried bob, and you carry a shoulder bag. A peeling lime-washed colonnade, a cycle-rickshaw and a fruit cart fill the background, with strong sun, deep shade and warm, grainy slide-film colour.
works: "Do not lighten, slim or beautify me" protects your real skin tone, which image models often shift. Garment specifics like "wide collar and cuffed sleeves" and "high-waisted cream pleated trousers" pin the silhouette to the decade. "35mm slide film" with "punchy warm colours" gives saturated but believable colour. "No readable shop signs" matters on a bazaar street, where models tend to invent text, and "not an illustration" keeps it a photograph.
tips: Use a full-length or three-quarter photo if you have one, so the model keeps your real height and build when it adds the trousers and walk.
If the sunglasses hide too much and your face drifts, change the line to "sunglasses pushed up on my head" and regenerate.
Try a parrot-green or electric-blue shirt, or swap the trousers for a flared denim skirt, while keeping the street and film details.
suits: Women who want a fashion-forward take on the 1980s trend instead of a saree look; great for Instagram posts, reels covers or comparing with a mother's or aunt's old street photos.
personalize: Change the shirt colour, the sunglasses shape and the street details to reflect the city your family comes from.

name: Eastern European Storybook Portrait
title: 1980s Storybook Illustration Prompt for ChatGPT & Gemini
description: Redraw your photo as a quirky Eastern European kids' book page in shaky ink. This 1980s storybook illustration prompt works in ChatGPT and Gemini.
prompt: Using my uploaded photo, redraw me as a character in a quirky 1980s Eastern European children's book illustration. This should be a drawing, not a photograph, but I must still be recognisable: keep my face shape, hairstyle, skin tone, eyes, nose, glasses or facial hair if I have them, and my general build, exaggerated gently as a caricature rather than replaced. Draw with thin, slightly trembling black ink lines, long awkward limbs, a solemn puzzled expression. Colour with flat gouache and watercolour washes in muted brick red, mustard, olive and dusty turquoise, with uneven edges and areas left unpainted. Show me walking a small dog past a lopsided tram stop and a leaning lamppost, with one bird watching. Print it on faded, slightly yellowed off-white paper with soft halftone texture, mild colour misregistration. No text, no speech bubbles, no modern objects or logos, not glossy digital art, not a 3D render.
intro: Children's books printed in Eastern Europe in the 1980s had a strange charm: wobbly ink, odd proportions, muted colours and characters who looked slightly worried. Seeing yourself drawn that way is funny and oddly touching, and it offers a break from the realistic photo edits most people are posting in the 1980s trend.
creates: This one is an illustration, not a photo. You appear as a lanky, gently caricatured figure walking a small dog past a crooked tram stop and lamppost. Your face shape, hair and any glasses remain recognisable. Lines are thin and shaky, colours are flat washes of brick red, mustard, olive and dusty turquoise, and the page looks like a faded old print with halftone dots and slightly misaligned colour.
works: "This should be a drawing, not a photograph, but I must still be recognisable" sets the honest goal, and listing "face shape, hairstyle, skin tone, eyes, nose" tells the model which traits to carry into caricature. "Slightly trembling black ink lines" and "areas left unpainted" produce the hand-made look. "Colour misregistration" and "yellowed off-white paper" mimic cheap print runs, while "not glossy digital art" blocks the smooth vector finish models often default to.
tips: Upload a clear photo with a distinctive feature visible, such as glasses, a fringe or a beard, since those details carry your likeness in a caricature.
If the drawing stops looking like you, reply "keep my exact hairstyle and face shape from the upload, less exaggeration" and regenerate.
Replace the dog and tram stop with a bicycle and a bakery, or a cat on a fence, to create a different page from the same book.
suits: People who like illustration and gentle humour more than realistic nostalgia; it makes a distinctive profile picture, a card for a friend or a playful contrast in a trend carousel.
personalize: Change the scene, the animal companion and the four-colour palette to build your own imagined storybook page.
